U_0x00818F: Flight form (Flyer Mode) of the Wild Rauptier Schnabel. The forward-mounted rail cannon gives better balance than before.
U_0x00827E:
The R-Blade is <Mao Industries>' simplified mass-production prototype <Personal Trooper> based on the R-1. It omits the R-1's flight transformation and <T-LINK System> (telekinesis sensor-amplifier) but performs well.
The R-Blade Custom refits prototype 3 for close combat, adding a <Tesla Drive>, Split Beam Cannon, and the Wild Wurger's jacket armor.
U_0x008530:
Developed under the "Halloween Plan," an upgrade program for the Gespenst series. It refines the base Mass-Prod Gespenst Mk-II into a practical field upgrade, boosting versatility and maintainability; parts fitted to its armor and hardpoints adapt it to varied missions.
Type-N is the most versatile of the three option sets, carrying an F2W Cannon and a Plasma Buckler on the left arm only.
